memberdef.name: buildOptimizedBinary

briefdescription.para: Generate the code to load the binary Op's target and argument onto the stack and perform the binary operation optimized for a Java primitive type.

detaileddescription.para: This method will also validate that the argument type matches the target type.
Neither the target nor argument should have been loaded to the stack.

parameterdescription.para: the current build context
the code builder to add the op codes to
the register containing the target of the operation
the register containing the operation argument

simplesect.para: the type of the result of the operation
